# scrollbar

The scrollbars a theme draws. `scrollbarStyle: native` (the default) leaves
every scrollbar to the platform; a theme that sets it to `custom` gets bars
drawn from the group's size, inset, radius and colour tokens, everywhere in its
scope.

The rules live in the ui-kit's `app.css`, behind
`@container style(--scrollbar-style: custom)`: WebKit drops the native bar as
soon as any `::-webkit-scrollbar` rule matches, so under `native` none may.
`no-scrollbar` (`<Scroll hideScrollbar>`) still hides a bar under either style.
